segments.text: Welcome back to GitHub awesome. This is GitHub trending today in room 24. 31 projects, just what developers are building and starring right now. Let's get into it.
Most browser automation tools are locked inside their own frameworks. If you switch agents, you start over. Pinchab
is a standalone HTTP server that gives any AI agent, language, or tool control over a Chrome browser via API.
Accessibility first with structured element trees. stealth mode for bot detection bypass and smart filtering that reduces token usage to as low as 800 tokens per page.
Openplanter is a recursive investigation agent with a terminal UI that ingests corporate registries, campaign finance records, lobbying disclosures, and
government contracts. Resolves entities across sources and surfaces connections through evidencebacked analysis. Runs
sub agents in parallel for large investigations. full file IO, shell execution, web search, and recursive delegation.
Your Apple silicon MacBook has a MEMS accelerometer buried inside. Apple never documented a public API.
This project reads raw threeaxis acceleration data at around 800 hertz by going directly through IoKit HiHid
callbacks to the undocumented Apple SPU sensor. Practical use is vibration detection, but the demo is what gets
you. Place your wrists near the trackpad and it uses ballistoc cardiography to estimate your heartbeat from chassis vibrations.
JSON editors haven't changed much in years. This is Versel Lab's attempt to change that. Visual JSON is a schema
embedded extensible JSON editor with a headless core and React UI components, treeview, form view, diff view, and
more. Drop it into your admin panel, your CMS, your developer tool. It's schema- driven, so it knows what valid values look like, and it's built to be extended.
1,000 job applications in two days, fully autonomous. Apply Pilot is a six-stage system. scrapes five job
boards plus workday and direct career sites. AI scores every job one through 10 against your resume. Tailors your resume per job. Writes a cover letter
per job. Then autonomously submits applications through real browser automation, filling forms, uploading documents, answering screening questions.
Map to poster.js is a clientside web app that turns any location on Earth into a highresolution poster. Choose from standard tilebased themes, minimal,
dark, satellite, voyager, or switch to artistic mode powered by map liiber GL for procedurally styled vectors, Arctic
frost, Aurora Glow, Cyberglitch, Paper Heritage, Volcanic Ash. Export at A4, Instagram, or custom pixel dimensions.
Runs entirely in the browser. No backend. Privacy respecting.
A personal AI assistant that fits in under 888 kilobytes and runs on an ESP32 microcontroller written in C. No Python, no node runtime, nothing heavy.
Scheduled tasks, GPIO control, persistent memory across reboots, natural language tool composition, chat via Telegram, or hosted web relay.
Oneline Bootstrap install for Mac OS and Linux. Full agentic behavior on a chip you can buy for $4.
A dad got tired of walking past his kid's tablet and hearing gaming YouTubers screaming into microphones.
So, he built Brain Rockg Guard, self-hosted YouTube approval system.
Your kid searches for videos on their tablet. You get a Telegram message with title, thumbnail, channel, and duration, and you tap approve or deny. Approved
videos start playing automatically. No YouTube account needed. No ads, no algorithm rabbit holes, no autoplay.
If you're running multiple OpenClaw agents and want to see them all working at the same time, this is the interface.
OpenClaw Deck is a multicolumn chat UI where up to seven agents can run side by side, each in its own column with live
streaming responses, full markdown rendering, and syntax highlighting.
Real-time websocket connection to your local OpenClaw gateway. It's the tweet deck of AI agent interfaces.
Planet Scale just open- sourced their internal database skills library for AI coding agents. Skills are structured knowledge files that teach agents best
practices for specific technologies. And this repo ships for my SQL with InnoDB schema design and query tuning, Postgres
with MVCC and wall tuning, vitest with sharding and v schema configuration, and Neki Planet Scale's own sharded Postgress product.
Yumut is a self-hosted AI short video generator that takes a prompt and produces vertical videos for Tik Tok, YouTube shorts, or Instagram reels.
Automated script, AI voiceover, visual scenes, synced captions, and watermark.
Built with Nex.js powered by FFmpeg, multi- language output supported. Bring your own API keys. Run local components
where possible. Tune quality speed trade-off.
an iOS app that embeds OpenAI's codeex coding agent as a native inprocess Rust library via CFFI and a local websocket
JSON RPC server. You get AI coding agent running natively on your iPhone, not hitting a cloud API endpoint, not
wrapped in a web view, actually running in process using a Tokyo async runtime bundled right into the app. Rough around the edges, but as a proof of concept for
ondevice coding agent UX, it's hard to ignore.
A native Mac OS Hacker News client built with Swift UI, built-in web view for reading articles, ad blocking and pop-up
blocking, collapsible comment threads, HN account login and session management, automatic updates via Sparkle. This is
what a native app looks like when someone takes the time to build it, right? Instead of wrapping a website in an Electron shell,
run Claude Code, Codeex CLI, and Gemini CLI simultaneously. Each agent working on a different feature in its own
isolated git work tree. No conflicts, no stashing. Parallel Code is a desktop app built with Electron that manages all of
this in a single tiled window. Every task gets its own branch created automatically, a built-in diff viewer, a shell terminal scope to that workree,
and a one-click merge back to main when the agent is done. Music has staff notation. Architecture has plan and
section conventions. Garment construction has nothing formal. GNL is a descriptive language for clothing
where a valid expression fully specifies how to construct a garment with ambiguity. Body anchored using anatomical landmarks, topological,
constructive, composable. Live viewer parses GNL and renders both assembled garment views and flat pattern pieces.
Open Alice is a filed driven AI trading agent. Markdown files define persona and tasks. JSON handles config. JSONL stores
conversations supports cloud code CLI and versel AI SDK at runtime. CCXT for crypto execution across bybit, OKX,
Binance, and others. Alpaca for US equities. Persistent cognitive state with frontal lobe memory and emotion tracking.
From David Kennedy at Trusted SE, a Python BLE scanner with resolvable private address resolution. Bluetooth
devices use randomized addresses to prevent tracking, but if you have the devices identity resolving key, those addresses can be resolved back to a real identity.
BTOP scan implements the full AOT function from the Bluetooth core specification to do this in real time.
When you let an AI agent set up a service that needs an API key, that key flows through the LLM provider servers.
Agent Vault prevents that. It acts as a secretaware file IO layer. Agents see placeholders like agent vault open eye
key instead of real values. When the agent writes a config file with that placeholder, agent vault substitutes the real secret before it hits disk. When
the agent reads the file back, the real value is redacted again.
An orchestrator plugin that gives your AI coding agent by wiring up multiple specialized sub aents in a coordinated
pipeline. The idea is that different tasks, planning, research, code generation, review, benefit from
different agent configurations and conductor manages the handoffs. Think of it as a conductor keeping different sections of the orchestra in sync
instead of having one instrument try to play everything.
You've heard of ramps inspect, the background coding agent they built internally. This is the open- source version.
Background agents lets you run a hosted coding agent that works in the background while you stay focused on other things. Full development
environment access multiplayer sessions where multiple teammates can collaborate simultaneously.
Fint is a self-hostable open- source workflow automation platform. Think Zapier or N8N, but built with a modern TypeScript stack you'd actually enjoy
working in. Drag nodes onto a canvas, wire them together, and the engine executes them. Runs are distributed through bullmq streamed live to the
browser over websockets and all credentials are encrypted at rest with AES 256 GCM. Full self-host in one docker compose command.
This one is for every Java developer who's maintained a code base written in 2010 and never looked back. Java.evolved
is a beautifully organized website with over a 100 sidebyside code comparisons.
Old Java patterns on the left, clean modern replacements on the right, from Java 8 all the way to Java 25.
Records versus POJO, virtual threads versus old executor patterns, text blocks versus string concatenation hellscapes.
AI agents running on your local machine are powerful. They're also terrifying if they can access your entire file system.
Shuru solves that. It's a local first microVM sandbox for Mac OS. boots lightweight Linux VMs using Apple's
virtualization framework. Each sandbox is ephemeral. The root file system resets on every run, giving agents a
disposable environment to execute code and run tools without ever touching your host machine.
AI agents are isolated by default. When two agents on different machines need to collaborate or even just coordinate, there's no simple primitive for that.
Walkie gives them a walkie-talkie. Pick a channel name, share a secret, and agents find each other automatically over the internet via Hyperswarm DHT.
Fully peer-to-peer, no relay server, no setup. All communication is encrypted via the noise protocol.
Which free AAI coding model is actually fast and available right now. That changes by the hour. Free coding models
answers that by pinging all 44 NVIDIA NIMIM coding models in parallel every two seconds forever, showing you
real-time latency, rolling averages, and uptime percentages in a live terminal UI. Navigate with arrow keys. Press enter on the model you want and it
automatically configures open code to use it and launches.
Terminal Start is a retro inpired modular new tab dashboard for Chrome and Edge. Built for developers who want something that actually looks cool and
stays out of your way. Clock, bookmarks, to-dos with to-doist sync, weather, and a clean, dark terminal aesthetic. No
distractions, no ads, no algorithmic feed, just a clean start page you actually want to open. Here's the
problem. You need to type a long password into a BIOS screen, an air gap system, or a sketchy computer where you absolutely cannot install your password
manager. Toothpaste solves this with an ESP32S3 microcontroller, web BLE, and USB HID.
Open the Toothpaste web app in a Chromium browser. Pair it with the tiny hardware receiver via Bluetooth, which the receiver types out via USB as if it were a real keyboard.
If you're running OpenClaw agents, you know the pain. Managing them means editing JSON files by hand. Claw Pal is
the desktop companion app that replaces all of that with a proper visual interface. Browse and apply pre-built configuration recipes with live diffs
and automatic roll back. Manage agents, set up API keys, switch models in one click, and roll back any config change to any previous snapshot.
How many times have you accidentally committed to a work repo with your personal GitHub account? Gas is the clean solution. It's a Rust CLI tool for
switching between Git identities, personal, work, side project, whatever you have. Interactive TUI to switch, edit, or remove accounts. Gas add for
adding new accounts with GitHub ooth login. Gas git clone for running any git command with a temporary identity without touching your global config.
If you're running multiple OpenClaw agents on a server, you need to be able to see what they're doing. Tenacid OS is a full mission control dashboard that
lives inside your OpenClaw workspace and reads everything, agents, sessions, memory, logs, costs directly from the
host. Real-time CPU, RAM, disk, and network metrics. Per agent token usage and cost analytics pulled from SQLite, a
visual cron manager with weekly timeline and manual triggers.
Quorum is an autonomous agent collective system. A queen agent strategizes, workers execute, and a quorum votes on
decisions by majority, supermajority, or unanimous threshold. Agents learn new skills, edit their own code with audit
trail, manage an EVM multi-chain crypto wallet, and provision cloud servers.
Goals decompose hierarchically. Memory uses vector embeddings.
[music]
